---
title: "Disease Severity Index Comparison"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: false
    number_sections: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(agricolae)

# Assumes disease.index.values exists with columns X13, X22, X31

disease.index.values <- read.delim("disease-index-values.tsv")

df_long <- pivot_longer(
disease.index.values,
cols = c(X13, X22, X31),
names_to = "Index",
values_to = "Value"
)


# One-way ANOVA

anova_model <- aov(Value ~ Index, data = df_long)
summary(anova_model)

# Fisher's LSD post hoc test

lsd <- LSD.test(anova_model, "Index", p.adj = "none")

letters_df <- data.frame(
  Index = rownames(lsd$groups),
  Letters = lsd$groups$groups
)

p <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Index, y = Value)) +
geom_boxplot(
  width = 0.6,
  outlier.shape = 21,
  outlier.size = 2,
  outlier.alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
  width = 0.12,
  size = 1.5,
  alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = letters_df,
    aes(
      x = Index,
      y = max(df_long$Value) * 1.05,
      label = Letters
      ),
    size = 5
    ) +
theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
labs(
x = NULL,
y = "Disease severity index"
) +
theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)
)

p


ggsave(
  filename = "disease_severity_index_boxplot.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 4,
  height = 4,
  units = "in"
  )

```
